captions.detailed: A heavy siege mortar with a short, wide-bore bronze barrel resting on a low, dark brown wooden trestle bed. The barrel is mounted on a thick transverse black metal trunnion cylinder that fits into cradle cutouts on the side plates of the bed. Beneath the breech, a trapezoidal elevation wedge slides along a central guide rail to adjust the angle of the barrel. The entire assembly is supported by four square wooden corner feet instead of wheels.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a historic siege mortar with a short, wide-bore barrel, a wooden trestle bed with four corner feet, and an adjustable elevation wedge. The barrel should be mounted on a central cylindrical trunnion to allow pitching, and the wedge should slide linearly underneath the breech.
captions.factory: Construct the main bed using box primitives for the side rails, crossbeams, and four square corner feet. Create the short, wide-bore barrel by combining a revolved profile or a series of cylinders with a hollowed bore, and attach a transverse cylinder through its center for the trunnions. Model the sliding elevation wedge as a trapezoidal prism on a central guide rail, and define revolute and prismatic joints to allow realistic tilting of the barrel and sliding of the wedge.
